Accommodation description

Thalassies Hotel is located in Limenaria, just in front of the sea and  200 m away from the centre of village. Hotel which was completely renovated in 2015 and offers various room types, restaurant, bar with a garden on the beach and swimming pool.

Hotel have double, triple and family rooms that view the aegean sea and the holy mountain, or the pool and mountains of thassos. 

Show full description Hide the rest

All rooms are furnished in the style of aegean architecture and feature: Satellite LCD TV, safe, telephone, refrigerator, free Wi-Fi internet, individually controlled air conditioning.

The hotel features a Greek tavern serving local specialities at a seaside terrace. Buffet-style breakfast is offered daily, while refreshing drinks and snacks can be enjoyed at the poolside bar.

• The breakfast is in buffet, and dinner consists of : Soup, salad choice (salad bar), choice between 2 main courses, desert.

We offer our guests a high level of service and greek hospitality.

Location and nearby beaches

Limenaria, Thassos

Limenaria is one of the main towns on the southern side of Thassos, offering a pleasant balance between coastal relaxation and local life. The town has a long promenade with cafés, taverns, and small shops, perfect for evening walks by the sea. Nearby Metalia Beach is particularly well-known for its impressive scenery and crystal-clear water. Accommodation in Limenaria includes family-run apartments, small hotels, and seaside guesthouses, many with views of the bay. The atmosphere is relaxed but not isolated, making it suitable for families, couples, and travelers who like having services close by. The town’s location is convenient for exploring both the southern and central parts of the island. With its mix of beaches, nature, and comfortable amenities, Limenaria offers a pleasant and easy-going summer holiday setting.
